description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Timeless Witness
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Timeless Witness
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
